core_categories: Retail Pharmacy; Pharmaceutical Distribution; OTC Healthcare; Para-pharmaceuticals; Unit-dose Medication Packaging
specialty_focus: Multipharma Belgium is a retail pharmacy cooperative and distributor operating over 320 pharmacies, with a focus on patient-centric care, preventive health, chronic disease follow-up, and vaccination support. It also provides pharmaceutical supply chain distribution and specialized unit-dose medication packaging services. The company does not appear to deal in wearable medical devices.
